result.summary: The page looks mostly well-formed, but there are a couple of layout issues where content is cut off near the edges and bottom navigation overlaps the feed area.

issues.description: The second item in the "Popular right now" section is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the lower part of the card hard to see or access.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so the last cards clear the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant row at the top is clipped on the right edge, with the next card only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase right-side padding or ensure the carousel spacing makes the partially visible next card look intentional and less cut off.
